thread:
Ariel Wang: Kinetic Health POC kickoff. They need a sandbox with ~4k de-identified records, redaction in ingest, eval harness, and clear KPIs. What's fastest path?
Connor Li: Presigned S3 upload + our ingest lambda that runs a scrub is fastest. Avoids IAM churn.
Maya Singh (SE): Agree. We can run a regex scrub for emails and mask account numbers during ingest. If they require PHI tokenization, flag as out-of-scope for 2-week POC.
Ravi (Security): For the security questionnaire: TLS in transit, S3 SSE-KMS for rest, and audit logs available. We'll provide a short SOC2 excerpt and retention policy.
Ariel Wang: KPIs the customer proposed: median latency <500ms, 90%+ accuracy on a 10-prompt eval, and stable performance at 8 QPS for 3 hours.
Maya Singh (SE): I'll prepare a 10-prompt eval set (mix of positive/negatives) and a scoring script (exact + fuzzy). Need their top-3 intents and 20 labeled examples by Day 1.
Connor Li: Upload options: presigned PUT POST example + curl snippet. If they prefer, one-time STS assume-role flow also works.
ops-bot: action: schedule ingest-scrub-job 2026-05-10T01:00:00Z - queued
Ariel Wang: Timeline suggestion: Day0: CSR/NDA + presigned instructions; Day1: upload + scrub; Day2-4: prompt tuning & nightly evals; Day5-10: stability tests and final report.
Ravi (Security): Blocker: VPC/private peering can add 5-10 business days; don't promise for initial pilot. Also request confirmation of deletion policy (we propose auto-delete after 30 days).
Maya Singh (SE): Next steps: I'll send eval template and scrub regex, Connor to send presigned examples, Ravi to draft security responses. Ariel to confirm upload timing with Kinetic.
